business_summary: American Electric Power Company, Inc. (Nasdaq: AEP) is a regulated electric utility holding company serving customers across 11 states, including Ohio, Texas, Virginia, West Virginia and Indiana, through subsidiaries such as AEP Ohio, AEP Texas and Appalachian Power. Its 8-K cover page confirms the primary listing is Nasdaq, not NYSE. It sits on the data-center-moratoria chain's utility-ratemaking-and-large-load-tariffs link (position 3, the HIGH-criticality bottleneck the chain's own note calls the single hardest number on this map): AEP Ohio won approval of one of the earliest state large-load data-center tariffs, converting a siting fight into a binding minimum-take contract. SEC companyfacts gives revenue, operating income, cash flow, debt and most of the quality block current through FY2025 and the 2026-03-31 balance-sheet instant.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/AEP.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 6944000000 less capital expenditure 3453000000, divided by revenue 21876000000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 from companyfacts. The capex_fy series jumps from 155000000 (FY2023) and 399000000 (FY2024) to 3453000000 (FY2025) in companyfacts, consistent with a change in which XBRL capital-expenditure tag was reported across filings rather than a 22-times increase in actual spending; see data_gaps.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 46544000000 (total debt 46850000000 less cash 306000000, both as of 2026-03-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 8644000000 (operating income 5319000000 plus depreciation and amortization 3325000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31). The balance sheet is more recent than the income statement; the ratio mixes the latest instant against the last full fiscal year.

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 66297926105.28 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 21876000000.

price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 66297926105.28 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 GAAP net income 3696000000.

ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 112841926105.28 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 21876000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 112841926105.28 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 3491000000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon (5-year 0.2007, 7-year 0.1538, 10-year 0.12). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.
